Rapid Deployment Minimal modifications required for existing checkout HW and SW. Actionable Insights Detailed reports and analytics enable continuous optimization. Business Impact Enhance shopper experience, prevent losses, and improve SCO efficiency. jobs.title: About us
jobs.description: About us - Shopic Home Platform Vision Loss Prevention Vision-Powered Smart Cart Retail media Store analytics Company About us News & Coverage Knowledge Careers Contact us Contact us Transforming Retail with Vision Technology. Today. Our Story Smooth Shopping, Smarter Checkout, Powered by Computer Vision & AI Bringing Intelligence to Every Touchpoint Shopic provides store digitalization solutions, blending the best of online commerce with physical retail. Our AI and computer vision technologies create personalized, seamless shopping experiences while empowering retailers with data-driven optimization to enhance operations and reduce losses. We envision a future where shopping is intuitive, stores are data-driven, and loss prevention is effortless—without disrupting the shopper experience. By harnessing real-time AI and computer vision, Shopic transforms every aspect of the retail journey. AI-Powered Smart Cart: Frictionless, Personalized Shopping Our unique clip-on device turns any standard shopping cart into a smart cart for the duration of a visit. Using computer vision and AI, it delivers: (1) Automated product recognition and checkout - Ensuring a frictionless experience. (2) Retail media and promotions – Hyper-targeted offers and ads, displayed exactly when and where shoppers select products. (3) Real-time analytics – Insights on shopper behavior, store inventory, and operational efficiency. Computer Vision-Powered Loss Prevention Shopic’s add-on secures every checkout touchpoint, reducing fraud and protecting revenue while maintaining a smooth shopper experience. Powered by real-time AI and product-level recognition, Shopic prevents self-checkout fraud instantly with ✓ 94%+ fraud detection accuracy ✓ Edge-based AI for real-time loss prevention ✓ Seamless integration with any SCO & POS systems ✓ Minimal false positives ✓ Cloud-native solution for rapid, scalable deployment With Shopic’s vision technology, retailers enhance security, streamline checkout, and unlock new revenue opportunities. Work with us Always Looking for Exceptional Talent Want to help us create new shopping experiences? View open positions Our people A Team of Stars Shopic’s team is one of the most experienced and capable forces in retail tech. It has created multiple AI-based solutions and gone through numerous development and deployment cycles. At heart, we are a software and data company. Still, we also design hardware, orchestrate manufacturing, integrate solutions in live commercial environments, and work intensively with our customers on the retail floor. It takes a special team to succeed in such a multidisciplinary endeavor. We have one. From AI-driven loss prevention for self-checkout to Smart Cart technology and other vision-based retail solutions, we leverage Computer Vision and Machine Learning to help retailers reduce shrink, improve operational efficiency, and deliver seamless shopping experiences. Our technology is deployed by major grocery retailers worldwide, and we're building one of the most advanced Edge AI platforms in the retail industry. Own the team's technical roadmap, architecture, execution, and project prioritization, aligning delivery with business goals. Design, build, and maintain scalable software and ML infrastructure across cloud and edge environments. Partner with AI Researchers to productionize Computer Vision and Deep Learning models into reliable, high-performance systems. Design and optimize inference pipelines with a focus on scalability, latency, and reliability. Drive engineering excellence through architecture reviews, code reviews, development best practices, and modern AI-assisted engineering workflows. Your Experience & Skills 6+ years of software development experience, including 3+ years leading software engineering or ML engineering teams. Strong hands-on experience with Python and C++ or Rust. Experience building, deploying, and maintaining production-grade Machine Learning systems. Strong understanding of software architecture, scalable system design, and performance optimization. Experience collaborating with AI, Machine Learning, or Computer Vision teams. Excellent leadership, communication, and organizational skills, with a strong ownership mindset. Experience using modern AI-assisted development tools (such as Cursor, Claude Code, or Codex) while maintaining high engineering quality. Nice to Have Hands-on experience developing and optimizing AI applications on NVIDIA edge platforms, particularly NVIDIA Jetson devices, including GPU acceleration and deployment on resource-constrained systems. Experience with modern AI and Computer Vision frameworks such as PyTorch, CUDA, TensorRT, NVIDIA DeepStream, and GStreamer. Experience with containerized and cloud-native development using Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD pipelines. Experience using agentic AI coding tools (such as Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, or similar) as part of the software development lifecycle to improve engineering productivity while maintaining code quality and best practices. Why Join Us? Build AI products deployed by leading retailers around the world. Lead a highly technical team working on real-world Edge AI challenges. Work alongside world-class AI researchers and software engineers. Influence product direction, architecture and engineering culture. Solve complex engineering problems at the intersection of AI, Computer Vision and retail innovation. Apply to this job Error: Contact form not found. This Privacy Notice also explains how we process, transfer, store and disclose the information collected, as well as your ability to control certain uses of the collected information. For the purposes of the EU General Data Protection Regulation and the UK Data Protection Law 2018 (together the “GDPR” ), as well as other applicable privacy laws, Shopic is a data controller ( “Controller” ) in relation to the Personal Data of the representatives of our customers and prospective customers, employees, employment prospects, partners, vendors and website visitors (these and any others with respect to whom we collect Personal Data as a Controller, shall collectively be referred to as “you” or “Data Subjects” ). If you are an individual located in the European Union/United Kingdom ( "EU/UK Individual" ), some additional terms and rights may apply to you, as detailed herein. Our registered office is Menachem Begin Road 156, Tel Aviv – Yafo, Israel 6492108 and our registration number is 515212629. We value your privacy and your rights as a data subject and have therefore appointed Prighter Group with its local partners as our privacy representative and your point of contact. Prighter gives you an easy way to exercise your privacy-related rights (e.g. requests to access or erase personal data). If you want to contact us via our representative Prighter or make use of your data subject rights, please visit the following website: https://prighter.com/q/19743258135. We also collect certain Personal Data automatically when you use the Site and/or Services. These processing activities are based on different legal bases including performance of a contract and our legitimate interests. 3. Additional Uses. We may compile statistical information based on anonymous and aggregated data we collect in order to help us understand customer needs. 4. Sharing the Personal Data We Collect. We share the Personal Data we collect with our service providers and subcontractors who assist us in the operation of the Site and process the information on our behalf and under our instructions. 5. We will ensure that we have agreements in place with such parties that ensure a similar level of privacy and data protection as set forth in this Privacy Notice. 6. Security. We implement measures aimed at protecting your Personal Data, but they do not provide absolute information security. Your Rights - How to Access and Limit Our Use of Certain Personal Data. Subject to applicable law and in addition to other rights as set forth below, you may have a right to access, update, delete, and/or obtain a copy of the Personal Data we have collected about you. 8. Data Retention. We retain Personal Data for as long as necessary for the purposes set forth in this Privacy Notice.
